title: Occupied Office Campus Renovation
scope: Two 5-storey occupied office buildings renovated floor by floor. Staff move to swing space; at least 8 of 10 floors stay in use at all times.
assume: Two buildings, 30 m × 20 m floor plates, 3.6 m floor-to-floor, 5 floors each (10 floors, about 60 staff per floor).
Each phase: move staff to swing space, strip-out, MEP, finishes, inspection, move back. Counter = floors in use; owner minimum 8 of 10.

E.n: Site grade

base.label: Baseline: one floor at a time

acts.n: Phase 1: move staff to swing space (Bldg A L1)
Phase 2: move staff to swing space (Bldg B L1)
Phase 3: move staff to swing space (Bldg A L2)
Phase 4: move staff to swing space (Bldg B L2)
Phase 5: move staff to swing space (Bldg A L3)
Phase 6: move staff to swing space (Bldg B L3)
Phase 7: move staff to swing space (Bldg A L4)
Phase 8: move staff to swing space (Bldg B L4)
Phase 9: move staff to swing space (Bldg A L5)
Phase 10: move staff to swing space (Bldg B L5)

two.label: Scenario: two floors at a time
two.note: Two floors per phase halves the duration, but needs swing space for twice the staff; 8 of 10 floors stay in use.

acts.n: Phase 1: move staff to swing space (Bldg A L1, Bldg B L1)
Phase 2: move staff to swing space (Bldg A L2, Bldg B L2)
Phase 3: move staff to swing space (Bldg A L3, Bldg B L3)
Phase 4: move staff to swing space (Bldg A L4, Bldg B L4)
Phase 5: move staff to swing space (Bldg A L5, Bldg B L5)

three.label: Scenario: three floors at a time
three.note: Three floors per phase is faster again, but only 7 of 10 floors stay in use: below the owner's minimum of 8.

acts.n: Phase 1: move staff to swing space (Bldg A L1, Bldg B L1, Bldg A L2)
Phase 2: move staff to swing space (Bldg B L2, Bldg A L3, Bldg B L3)
Phase 3: move staff to swing space (Bldg A L4, Bldg B L4, Bldg A L5)
Phase 4: move staff to swing space (Bldg B L5)
